app_store.name: Jarvis Office
app_store.subtitle: Offline personal office suite
app_store.promotional_text: Works without internet. No account needed. Write, calculate, plan and draw — all in one place.
app_store.description:
Jarvis Office is a personal office suite that runs entirely in your browser.

No account. No cloud. No internet required.

Everything is stored on your device. Close the app and reopen it — your work is still there.

What you get:
- Write: document editor with formatting and auto-save
- Calc: spreadsheet with SUM/AVG/MAX formulas
- Calendar: month, week and day views with event management
- Notes: pinned notes with full-text search
- Matrix: smart table with filters and column types
- Draw: freehand canvas
- Present: slide editor
- Mail: local email reader

Built for WCAG AA accessibility. Keyboard navigable throughout. Dark theme.

Free, open source.
app_store.whats_new: Version 2: new design system, WCAG AA accessibility, improved formula engine, redesigned calendar.
